referencePolicy: Stockholm GPU regional; all other resource-region groups pooled.
routingRule: Choose the lowest aggregate rolling MAE family separately per resource-region. Exact ties prefer persistence, then pooled, then regional.
blendingRule: For each resource and horizon, choose one global-across-regions correction weight from the fixed grid by aggregate rolling MAE. Exact ties prefer smaller weight.
selectionRule: Per resource, choose lowest aggregate rolling MAE candidate only if no rolling fold is worse than reference; exact ties prefer reference then reference-blend. Otherwise retain reference.
limitations: All later diagnostic periods were previously examined. No fresh blind-test claim.
OOF labels fit policy choices, so reported selection errors are optimistic development metrics, not unbiased policy test results.
Recipe originated in earlier experiments; chronological data/label guards do not erase historical recipe-selection effects.
No serving changes or scheduling-savings claim.

futureEvaluation.newRegionalData: Next available public archive dates on or after 2026-10-01, before any policy tuning on those regional outcomes.
futureEvaluation.stockholmData: Newly collected dates on or after 2026-10-25; all existing October comparisons remain reused.
futureEvaluation.rule: Freeze this policy before import/scoring; compare identical target cohorts against persistence and existing reference. No automatic deployment.
